scope: One additive covering index and exact matching migration ledger entry; no source data, grants, RLS, functions, Auth, scheduler or old index changes
rationale: The actual narrow Trending ID query still hit the existing PostgreSQL 3-second limit. Its installed ordering index requires heap reads for cover_image filtering. The covering index allows an index-only plan including generic prepared queries.
caveats: Local timings are memory-resident, not hosted storage-cold proof.
Hosted planner visibility estimate is 1705/4721 pages; an index-only scan can still fetch heap tuples until ordinary vacuum visibility permits skipping them.
Hosted benefit must be measured before merge/deployment. If the reviewed benefit/compatibility checks fail, roll back only this new index and exact ledger entry and stop release.
The existing older ordering index is retained. Approximately1.15MB additional storage and extra relevant-write maintenance are expected.
No manual VACUUM, configuration change, timeout increase or extra migration is authorized.

application.mergeAndProductionDeployment: Separate exact-head approval required, conditional on CI and real cold-request acceptance

recovery: Existing verified R3/R4, uploaded catalogue-state supplement and newly verified/uploaded encrypted email configuration are preserved; no source/user row mutation is proposed
